doctrine: For each numbered line: is each plain-word card TRUE to the KJV word as used in THAT verse (not just a dictionary swap)? Could any hook card imply a claim the verse does not make, or cheapen Christ's words? Mark each line OK / CHANGE (give exact better wording) / CUT.
esl: Is each plain word the clearest common modern word and is it accurate? Quote the verse phrase it sits on. Mark OK / CHANGE (exact wording) / CUT. Also flag any hook card that a worldwide scroller would misread.
viewer: Judge each HOOK card: does it stop a scroll in 1 second, is it honest to what the piece actually delivers, does it fit a reverent gospel channel (no clickbait, no fear-mongering)? Mark OK / CHANGE (exact wording) / CUT. Name the 3 best and 3 weakest.
judge: Judge all cards as a whole: what is wrong, what is doubtful, what is great. Mark every line OK / CHANGE (exact wording) / CUT. Then list the 5 changes that matter most.
